h2.scope: diagnostic sensitivity of a conduction plus latent model, not a fit; no diameter selected; cannot separate H1 from H2 because irradiance, keyhole and cavity effects of a smaller beam are not modelled

declaration.model: conservative latent enthalpy, projected volumetric source, sampled source-depth closure

limitations: Constant nominal IN625 properties from 21 C tables applied up to the liquidus; legacy-estimated secondary values.
Fusion enthalpy 290 kJ/kg and the 1290..1350 C linear mushy fraction are a literature screening model.
No fluid flow, recoil, free cavity, evaporation, multiple reflection or absorptivity enhancement is modelled.
Coarse closure on front_coarse; fine and domain controls are same-source single solves, not re-closures.
Front-band z refinement was designed around a synthetic 60..75 um front; other depths are not pre-qualified.
Finite sampled roots are not completeness or uniqueness certificates.

Zero-latent N3 used an infinite domain; this model uses a Dirichlet T0 box, so domain truncation differs. N3 also used a temperature residual on 0..500 um; this closure uses the Dref window closure on 0..120 um. Latent heat is therefore credited only against the same-pipeline L = 0 control units.

The 120 um search cap bounds the closure depth. A closure whose residual is positive at the cap is reported as residual-positive-at-search-cap, a lower bound on depth, never as a root or a prediction.
The beam-diameter sensitivity uses a conduction plus latent model. Irradiance, keyhole onset and cavity effects of a smaller beam are not modelled, so the arm cannot separate H1 from H2.
Not experimental validation; original N3 and N4 gates are untouched.
